briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Judge the Noon Court Boss Dais: Gate Verdict. Enter Noon Court Boss Dais on Sun-Scale Verdict Descent through The Sun-Scale Gate while the Gate remains Stable Gate under Ma’at strain. Reference deity voice is Amunet, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, defeat the boss encounter against The Misweighed Dawn Judge inside the elite-tuned Noon Court Boss Dais and complete the Ascension route without breaking canon.

missionIntro.speaker: Amunet Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: The scale waits for weight, not noise. The Noon Court Boss Dais will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the boss pressure of Sun-Scale Verdict Descent made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: black Nile silt channels that preserve memory and expose bloodline echoes

victory.speaker: Amunet Divine Voice
victory.text: The verdict remains harsh, but it names us lawful.

defeat.speaker: Amunet Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The Sun-Scale Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Noon Court Boss Dais as part of Sun-Scale Verdict Descent.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Noon Court Boss Dais as a boss node in Sun-Scale Verdict Descent; Aten sun-discs with life-giving hand-rays, electrum collars, nemes-like light mantles, faience turquoise and lapis inlays, black Nile silt glass, red desert jasper, scarab engines, Ma’at feather geometry, solar barque arcs, pylon harnesses, lion/cobra/falcon/jackal threshold masks, lotus-papyrus river courts, and white-gold noon light.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.
